extracted_mechanism: A proposed adapter-only diff is applied only to a disposable sandbox copy, then checked against a hash-bound regression manifest with no production write path.
ace_symptom: ACE has sandbox counterexample and test-batch evidence, but no dedicated research contract for source-level adapter mutation proposals.
transfer_hypothesis: A disposable-copy mutation probe can preserve evolutionary exploration while rejecting regression, timeout, path-escape, or network-dependent proposals as EVOLUTION_REJECTED.
counterexample_question: Can an apparently harmless adapter diff alter a protected import, reach a forbidden path, or pass a partial test selection while failing the declared full manifest?
next_verification: Map existing adapter boundaries and test-batch receipts; design a fixture-only RED case for path escape and incomplete manifest coverage before any sandbox executor is proposed.
